# WC11 · Patient 360 · CRM & CSKH

Group **WC · Hồ sơ & Patient 360** · tab · Next.js: **built (U1)** (`/patients/[id]`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/crm-ui.js#patient`
- Patient 360 is `clinic.js › patient360()`: hero, tab bar (`data-tab`), then one body per tab. `care-finance.js` injects the linked service/prescription panels under every tab except `crm` and `history`.
- `PemaCRMUI.patient(p)`: summary, "Bối cảnh chăm sóc" facts, open tasks, clinical context; buttons "Sửa ngày dự kiến" (WC18) and the care actions.
- Inventory note: Mapped to the care cards of the Tổng quan tab in the Next.js app.
- Page key `patient` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor, care, accountant (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- Controls removed for roles without the capability: `modal=note` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor); `tab=session` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor).
- Patient 360 tabs removed for role care: consult, session, photos.
- Patient 360 tabs removed for role accountant: consult, session, photos, crm.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"patients\"]"} → {"click":"tr[data-patient=\"P001\"]"} → {"wait":".patient-hero"} → {"click":"[data-tab=\"crm\"]"}; it must show `[data-crm="expected"]`.

## Next.js target
- Route: `/patients/[id]` · status: **built (U1)** · U step: U1
- FEATURE-INVENTORY row: `/patients/[id]` "Patient 360" (owner U1, U3); test ids: `src/lib/ops/format.test.ts`, `src/components/ops/patient/patient-360-view.test.tsx`, `src/components/ops/patient/consult-tab.test.tsx`, `src/components/ops/patient/plan-tab.test.tsx`, `src/components/ops/patient/session-tab.test.tsx`, `src/components/ops/patient/photos-tab.test.tsx`, `src/lib/ops/patient-tabs.test.ts`, `src/lib/ops/session-form.test.ts`, `src/lib/ops/plan-form.test.ts`, `src/lib/ops/media-upload.test.ts`
- Existing page file: `pema-agent/frontend/src/app/(admin)/patients/[id]/page.tsx`

## Required text (keep verbatim)
- Chưa có hoạt động CSKH được ghi nhận. (empty state)

## Business rules
- Clinical actions need the `clinical` capability (owner, doctor); without it `action()` answers "Cần tài khoản bác sĩ để thực hiện." and `staff-context.js › apply()` removes the controls.
- "Nếu đã có lịch thực tế, Patient 360 ưu tiên ngày lịch đó. Khuyến nghị vẫn được giữ khi hủy lịch."

## Differences from the app design
- (none recorded)

## Gotchas
- Opening a patient from the list is a row click (`tr[data-patient]`) or the "Mở →" button; the tab is kept in the module variable `tab`, so a re-render keeps it.
- The tab is hidden for the accountant role.
